fields.name: WorkspaceId
fields.description: ItemId of the owning Workspace.

fields.name: ReaderIds
fields.description: Server-stamped ACL: IAM user ids that may read the row.

fields.name: CreatedByUserId
fields.description: IAM user id of the creating actor, set by the function.

fields.name: UpdatedByUserId
fields.description: IAM user id of the last writer.

fields.name: ProjectId
fields.description: ItemId of the Project this row belongs to.

fields.name: Number
fields.description: Change request number within the project.

fields.name: Lane
fields.description: Request lane. One of: change|enhance|add|fix.

fields.name: FeatureRef
fields.description: Reference to the affected feature.

fields.name: Title
fields.description: Request title.

fields.name: Description
fields.description: Request description.

fields.name: Status
fields.description: Request status. One of: draft|analysing|questions|review|approved|rejected|building|released-dev|promoted-stage|promoted-production|failed (requested|cancelled: earlier rows).

fields.name: Version
fields.description: Version the request was released in.

fields.name: RequestedByUserId
fields.description: IAM user id of the requester.

fields.name: EngineJobId
fields.description: ItemId of the related EngineJob.

fields.name: Analysis
fields.description: Analysis JSON (version 1) written by the engine (change.analyse); answers are added by cr.answer.

fields.name: AnalysedAt
fields.description: When the latest analysis finished (change.analyse).

fields.name: DecidedAt
fields.description: When the change was approved or rejected (cr.decide).

fields.name: DecidedByUserId
fields.description: IAM user id of who approved or rejected the change (cr.decide).

fields.name: DecisionNote
fields.description: Optional reason or note given with the decision (cr.decide).

fields.name: SelfApproved
fields.description: True when the requester approved the change as the only eligible approver (cr.decide).

fields.name: Checks
fields.description: The change's own checks after each of its deploys, its fix rounds and a revert (JSON version 1, src/domain/changeChecks.ts parseChangeChecks), written by the engine (change.build): environment, version, commits, failing checks by name with a short reason.

fields.name: RequestKey
fields.description: Idempotency key <op>:<requestId>[:<n>], set by the server; unique index.
